title: CommandRequest
description: The body of POST /v1/commands/{action} (docs/design/m0/08 "Reads, commands, events"). The action is the path's, one per entry in the action registry. The writer runs it once per (actor, idempotency_key): a repeat with the same input returns the stored result, one with a different input is refused with failed/idempotency_key_reused (03).

expected.description: The exact revision of the object the caller inspected (version 0: it does not exist yet). Never filled in by the client library on the caller's behalf [M13]; a mismatch is refused with failed/stale_expected_state.

scope.description: The action's parameters, including the object it applies to; one schema per action, from the action registry.

reason.description: Why the caller asks, recorded with the command.
